basic_details.job_title: NALCO Executive Director Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: National Aluminium Company (NALCO) is recruiting for 2 Executive Director (M & R Complex) / E09 and Executive Director (Project) / E09 vacancies with a pay scale of 150000-Rs. 3,00,000 plus perks, allowances, and medical facilities. Eligible candidates possessing the required engineering qualifications can apply online from 1 October 2026 to 21 October 2026. Applicants must complete the online application and submit the fee through SBI Collect by the last date of 21 October 2026. The selection process involves shortlisting based on online application details followed by a Personal Interview.

age_limit.details: Upper age limit as on 21.10.2026 shall not exceed 56 years including all possible age relaxations.

selection_process: Shortlisting of candidates will be done based on information and declarations submitted during online application
weightages assigned to percentage of marks in essential qualifications
and experience in companies with a turnover of 250 crores or more or listed companies. Experience from Mining
and Manufacturing/Production sectors carries additional weightage. Eligible candidates will be called post-wise and category-wise in a ratio of 1:10 for the final assessment
which will be made through Personal Interview (PI) only.
how_to_apply: Visit the official NALCO website at www.nalcoindia.com and go to the career section.
Read the instructions carefully and pay the application/processing fee through SBI Collect following the specified SBI Collect instructions.
Note down the State Bank Collect Reference Number and date of payment.
Fill out the online application form with accurate details and enter the SBI Collect Reference Number.

Upload self-attested scanned copies of recent passport size colour photograph, signature, qualification proofs, experience proofs, salary slips, Form 16 (for last 2 years where applicable), and Format-1 or Format-2 certificates as mandated.
Submit the online application before 21.10.2026 (05:00 PM) and keep a hard copy of the submitted application for future reference.
important_instructions: Candidates should be in employment at the time of applying for the post. A candidate can apply for one post only. Applying for more than one post attracts cancellation of candidature. Internal candidates who fulfill requirements will be considered along with other candidates, and age limit and application fees are not applicable to internal candidates. Experience of candidates working on contract basis through an empanelled agency or contractor will not be considered; only direct work experience including fixed-term employment is accepted. All documents submitted by the applicant must be self-certified. Candidates called for personal interview will be reimbursed travelling allowances limited to economy class air fare for to and fro journey by the shortest route. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature.

rows.details: Executive Director (M & R Complex) and Executive Director (Project)
Minimum 24 years post-qualification relevant experience (including 2 years in E8 grade or higher in IDA scale Rs. 120000-280000/- or CDA scale Rs. 144200-218200/- L-14)
Multi-locational plants and offices with Corporate Office at Bhubaneswar, Odisha
Online via NALCO website career section

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Qualification: Engineering graduate in Chemical / Mechanical / Electrical with a good academic record from a recognised university or institution. Candidates holding an MBA or Post Graduate Diploma in Management will have an added advantage. Experience: Minimum 24 years of post-qualification experience as an Executive in PSUs or reputed/leading organisations. Must have at least 5 years of experience during the last ten years at a Senior Management level in Technical, Operations, or Maintenance in an Alumina Refinery. Must have wide exposure to Alumina Refinery operations, Aluminium Smelter operations, Captive Power Plant, Production Planning, process optimization, technology upgradation, and expansion projects. Qualification: Engineering graduate in Mechanical / Electrical / Civil with a good academic record from a recognised university or institution. Candidates holding an MBA or Post Graduate Diploma in Management will have an added advantage. Experience: Minimum 24 years of post-qualification experience as an Executive in PSUs or reputed/leading organisations. Must have at least 10 years of experience during the last 20 years in Project management (Planning, execution, formulation, engineering, commercial) of large industrial projects. Must have wide exposure and proven experience in planning, execution, and commissioning of large industrial, metallurgical, or power projects, including Greenfield and Brownfield projects, EPC/EPCM contract management, procurement, vendor management, construction management, commissioning activities, statutory clearances, regulatory compliances, budgeting, cost control, and risk management. Upper age limit as on 21.10.2026 shall not exceed 56 years including all possible age relaxations.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Selected candidates for E09 grade will be placed in the pay scale of Rs. 150000 - 300000/-. In addition to Basic Pay and DA in the Industrial DA pattern, benefits include Perks (35% of basic pay), Performance Related Pay based on company and individual performance, company accommodation or HRA, medical facilities for self and family, post-retirement medical benefit, leave encashment, pension as per NPS, contributory provident fund, and gratuity as per company rules.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NALCO Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official NALCO website at www.nalcoindia.com and go to the career section. Read the instructions carefully and pay the application/processing fee through SBI Collect following the specified SBI Collect instructions. Note down the State Bank Collect Reference Number and date of payment. Fill out the online application form with accurate details and enter the SBI Collect Reference Number. Upload self-attested scanned copies of recent passport size colour photograph, signature, qualification proofs, experience proofs, salary slips, Form 16 (for last 2 years where applicable), and Format-1 or Format-2 certificates as mandated. Submit the online application before 21.10.2026 (05:00 PM) and keep a hard copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Shortlisting of candidates will be done based on information and declarations submitted during online application, criteria in Table-1 and Table-2, weightages assigned to percentage of marks in essential qualifications, minimum required experience, additional years of experience, and experience in companies with a turnover of 250 crores or more or listed companies. Experience from Mining, Metallurgical, Chemical, Power, and Manufacturing/Production sectors carries additional weightage. Eligible candidates will be called post-wise and category-wise in a ratio of 1:10 for the final assessment, which will be made through Personal Interview (PI) only.

content_sections.heading: NALCO Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates should be in employment at the time of applying for the post. A candidate can apply for one post only. Applying for more than one post attracts cancellation of candidature. Internal candidates who fulfill requirements will be considered along with other candidates, and age limit and application fees are not applicable to internal candidates. Experience of candidates working on contract basis through an empanelled agency or contractor will not be considered; only direct work experience including fixed-term employment is accepted. All documents submitted by the applicant must be self-certified. Candidates called for personal interview will be reimbursed travelling allowances limited to economy class air fare for to and fro journey by the shortest route. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies in NALCO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for Executive Director positions (1 for M & R Complex and 1 for Project) in E09 grade.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply online for NALCO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online applications is 21.10.2026 up to 05:00 PM, while the last date for submitting the application fee is 21.10.2026 up to 04:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required educational qualification for Executive Director posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must be Engineering graduates in Chemical, Mechanical, or Electrical (for M & R Complex) or Mechanical, Electrical, or Civil (for Project) with a good academic record from a recognised university or institution.

faq.question: Q4. What is the upper age limit for NALCO Executive Director Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum upper age limit of the applicants shall not exceed 56 years as on 21.10.2026 including all possible age relaxations.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay scale for NALCO Executive Director posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be placed in the E09 grade pay scale of Rs. 150000 - Rs. 300000/-.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: General and OBC (NCL) candidates are required to pay Rs. 1000/- as an application fee, whereas SC/ST candidates pay Rs. 500/- as processing fee. Internal candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected for these positions?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted based on qualifications, experience, and sector weightages in a 1:10 ratio, followed by a Personal Interview (PI).

faq.question: Q8. Are allowances paid in addition to the basic pay?
faq.answer: Yes, benefits include perks (35% of basic pay), performance related pay, company accommodation or HRA, medical facilities, post-retirement medical benefit, leave encashment, pension as per NPS, contributory provident fund, and gratuity.
